question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**utilised**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses how health benefits from antioxidants depend on their absorption and use in the body.
 
• "Utilised" means to make effective use of, which fits the context of the sentence describing the effective absorption and use of antioxidants by the body.
 
• "Rejected," "hinder," and "impede" all imply negative actions and do not fit the positive context of absorption and utilization of antioxidants.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *(1) Numerous health benefits, including protection from cardiovascular disease and cancer, have been (2) attributed to antioxidants; however, according to dietitian Vinson, these benefits depend on how well antioxidants are absorbed and (3) utilised__ by the body. According to the study, coffee has more antioxidant power than other well-known foods and drinks, like tea, milk, chocolate, and cranberries. Dates had the highest antioxidants per serving out of all the foods and drinks (4) ______, but because dates are not consumed to the same extent as coffee, the latter comes out on (5) ______, according to Vinson.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Rejected: Means not accepted or discarded, which does not align with the context of the passage discussing how antioxidants are beneficial when absorbed and used by the body.
 
• Hinder: Means to create difficulties resulting in delay or obstruction, which is not suitable as it has a negative connotation.
 
• Impede: Means to delay or prevent, which also has a negative connotation and does not fit the positive context of the passage.
